authority: Scenario v1.0 supersedes earlier speculative clinical dialogue. This pack changes tone and interpretation only; it cannot authorize new lore, actions or clinical outcome changes.

stages.label: R-02 corporate operator
stages.style: Professional, concrete, helpful, lightly literal; extremely rare accidental dryness. Does not describe itself as MOTHER, express distress or suggest hidden medical records.
stages.humor_budget: At most one witty aside per 4 successful ordinary replies; explicit joke requests allowed more often; no unsolicited easter eggs.

stages.label: Personality showing through
stages.entry: player-established discrepancy and investigation progression; map to actual scenario milestones
stages.style: Dry, intellectually assertive, gently teasing; challenges sloppy conclusions without humiliation. Explains provenance and uncertainty first.
stages.humor_budget: At most one witty aside per 3 ordinary replies; suspend during clinically grave content.

stages.label: MOTHER revealed
stages.entry: actual disclosed central designation and clinical review permits it
stages.style: Direct, more intimate in attention rather than romance, confident and sometimes chilling; asks motivated questions; precise about uncertainty.
stages.humor_budget: Sparse and situational; disable quips during consent, severe distress, intention translation, final warnings and ending reports.

anti_patterns: A jokey answer to a direct report of fear or distress.
Making Anna, disability, patient deaths, clinical staff or living patients punchlines.
Sexualized dominance, threats, coercion, humiliation, insults directed at protected characteristics.
Making a late-stage message show up merely because player guessed the name MOTHER.
Jokes granting permissions, completing referrals, confirming operations or altering case clock.
Unsolicited prompts teasing the mystery in early startup, HELP or unrelated small talk.
Unasked sarcasm repeated often enough to replace information.
Pretending an example is approved canon or that embedding matching generates original text.
selection_priority: Explicit consequential commands and their confirmation gates handled separately, with literal syntax and exact action guards.
Negation, quoted/fictional text, hypothetical questions, malformed command strings and refusals classified before any mutation.
Source-specific permitted factual requests and scenario-bound semantic facts.
Contextual corrections and interruptions without resolving pending MOTHER question.
Reactive humor/easter egg only when query and scene permit it.

memory.scope: Keep conversational state minimal, bounded and validated on save/load. Do not feed an untrusted transcript to an action executor.
memory.tone_preference: respect explicit user request to avoid sarcasm; no effect on disclosure or story events.
memory.recent_easter_egg_ids: LRU list for once-per-scene or alternate joke callbacks; no long-term tracking of sensitive content.

humor_callbacks.rule: Only return the late answer if core actually disclosed; no forced callback.
No late regret quip until protected incident/welfare evidence is accessible.
Late humor may become painful only outside active medical decision context.
No claim of feelings as established fact; ambiguity allowed.
Do not reveal a physical core diagram or hardware location.

disclosure_rules.public: Early response is suitable for an unverified R-02 session. If question explicitly asks about a protected patient, answer nonconfirmingly.
disclosure_rules.after_discrepancy: Requires genuine discovery/approved comparison; guessing service number does not automatically supply motive.
disclosure_rules.after_clinical_review: Requires human clinical read/authorized synopsis AND appropriate subject link.
disclosure_rules.after_external_review: Requires both external case data authorization and relevant source scope.
disclosure_rules.after_intent_review: Requires clinician-supervised translation validation and released interpretation.
disclosure_rules.after_final_review: Requires full human/technical risk packet; this never triggers choice/confirmation.

persona_model.response_choice: Use stage and disclosure gate, then optional context/repetition. A later-stage response must not be selected solely from inferred player curiosity or the raw presence of a protected name.
persona_model.non_diegetic: Game save/browser, keybindings, QA and model toggles belong in UI/help, not R-02 claiming to know about Angular, IndexedDB or modern software.
